scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @eyewear/storefront && npm run build --workspace @eyewear/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @eyewear/storefront && npm run lint --workspace @eyewear/backend && composer --working-dir=apps/backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @eyewear/storefront && npm run typecheck --workspace @eyewear/backend
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
